g.text: dotted black: the ESTIMATED effect, at the fitted thetas | each source at its OWN published value
CONDITIONAL (solid line): banded or reported at a value -- the line is the range it covers
MARGINAL (whisker): no contrast reported, so admixr2 integrates over the population enrolled -- 10th-90th over 2.5th-97.5th
a source off the dotted line is one the meta-analysis does not reproduce | grey: extrapolation
Estimated covariate effect against its sources
